_comment: Parameters of the uncertainty-aware constraints. Each block is switched on by its own CLI flag (--sw_margin, --derating, --redundancy, --ai_contention, --robust_latency); --uncertainty switches on all of them. Values are the ones previously hard-coded in optimizer.py / architecture_loader.py.

sw_margin._comment: SW resource demand multiplier = 1 + asil_margin + ai_margin, applied only to SCs of the listed domains.

derating._comment: Partition capacity at a location is multiplied by its health factor. Applied to every generated location.

redundancy._comment: SCs with 'redundant_with' must not be placed at the same location. No parameters.

ai_contention._comment: At most max_per_location SCs requiring ai_hw_feature may be placed at the same location.

robust_latency._comment: Robust link latency = nominal * network_safety_factor + sync_error_constant + platform_overhead.
